[F002] All 15 tests pass and the seed validates directly against the JSON Schema. Summary of how each round-i0 finding was addressed:

**Finding 1 (high, correctness — seed fails JSON Schema on `introduced_commands: null`):** Removed the `introduced_commands: null` key from all three Experience Readiness advisory actions in `docs/upgrade/releases.json` (consumer-outcome-gate, evidence-typing, degraded-honesty) and synced the byte-identical packaged copy at `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/data/releases.json`. Advisories now simply omit the key (the schema permits only an array when present). Both files now pass `jsonschema.validate` against `upgrade-releases.schema.json`. I also added `test_seed_validates_against_json_schema`, which validates the contract directly rather than relying solely on the Pydantic loader (which had tolerated the null).

**Finding 2 (high, correctness — schema not shipped as package data):** Mirrored the canonical `claude/shared/schemas/v1.0/upgrade-releases.schema.json` into `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/data/upgrade-releases.schema.json`. The existing `data/*.json` glob in `[tool.setuptools.package-data]` (wheel) and the `include scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/data/*.json` line in `MANIFEST.in` (sdist) now cover it; I updated the comments in both files to document the schema shipping under D049. A drift-guard test (`test_packaged_schema_matches_canonical`) asserts the mirror stays byte-identical to the canonical source.
